title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: which particulars may be corrected, and the originals-return setting
content:
## Scope

This matrix covers, for each Bills of Lading and Transport Documents type, the printed particulars that may be corrected after issuance while the vessel has not departed, the particulars that may be corrected once it has departed, whether all outstanding originals must be returned before an issued document is corrected, and the number of calendar days from a correction request within which required originals must be returned, failing which the request lapses.

## Particulars correctable after issuance

| Document type | After issuance, before departure | After departure |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Sea Waybill | consignee name, notify party name, cargo description, package count, gross weight, port of discharge | consignee name, notify party name, cargo description, gross weight |
| AHL Electronic Bill of Lading | consignee name, notify party name, cargo description, package count, gross weight, port of discharge | consignee name, notify party name, cargo description, gross weight |
| AHL Straight Bill of Lading | notify party name, cargo description, package count, gross weight | notify party name, gross weight |
| AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading | notify party name, cargo description, package count, gross weight, port of discharge | notify party name, gross weight |
| AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading | notify party name, cargo description, package count, gross weight, port of discharge | notify party name, gross weight |
| AHL Switch Bill of Lading | notify party name, cargo description | notify party name |

## Originals-return setting

| Document type | All outstanding originals returned before an issued document is corrected | Days from the correction request to return the originals |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Sea Waybill | No | 0 |
| AHL Electronic Bill of Lading | No | 0 |
| AHL Straight Bill of Lading | Yes | 14 |
| AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading | Yes | 14 |
| AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading | Yes | 14 |
| AHL Switch Bill of Lading | Yes | 10 |

A return period of 0 appears only on the two types whose originals-return setting is No.

## Points of judgement

**May the port of discharge be corrected on an AHL Straight Bill of Lading after issuance?** No; it is not in that type's list before departure or after departure.

**After departure, which particulars remain correctable on an AHL Switch Bill of Lading?** Only the notify party name.

**Is the shipper name in any list?** No type lists the shipper name as correctable after issuance.

**On which types must the originals come back before an issued document is corrected?** On the AHL Straight, AHL Negotiable, AHL Combined Transport and AHL Switch Bills of Lading.
